name: SikaProof® Bentonite Powder
summary: SikaProof® Bentonite Powder is a natural sodium bentonite powder used as an ancillary product for the installation of the SikaProof Bentonite below ground waterproofing system.
metaDescription: SikaProof® Bentonite Powder is a natural sodium bentonite powder used as an ancillary product for the installation of the SikaProof Bentonite below ground waterproofing system.
attributes: Part of the BRANZ Appraised SikaProof Bentonite system (Appraisal No. 612 [2008])
usage: SikaProof® Bentonite Powder is used for making a detailing compound and for filling large voids.
advantages: Part of the BRANZ Appraised SikaProof Bentonite system (Appraisal No. 612 [2008])
packaging: The SikaProof® Bentonite System is made up of the following items, each sold separately: System Component | Packaging SikaProof® Bentonite Sheet | 1.1 m wide x 10m roll SikaProof® Bentonite Sheet | 2.2 m wide x 10m roll SikaProof® Bentonite Paste | 20 litre pails SikaProof® Bentonite Powder | 25 kg bags

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: Three (3) years from date of manufacture if stored correctly.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in a cool, dry, well-ventilated area, out of direct sunlight. Store away from incompatible materials. Ensure that storage conditions comply with applicable local and national regulations. Protect from freezing.

items.label: APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS
items.text: Refer to the SikaProof® Bentonite system data sheet and Method Statement for full installation instructions. Note! SikaProof® Bentonite Powder can only be installed by Sika NZ Approved Contractors.
